commentary: lovedogs disliked the broad simultaneous turn-off, substantial face-up darkness and flat-looking larger table (#55). Ibrakeforpossums observed that a preference for stronger contrast can legitimately differ (#56). The buyer later obtained ASET, purchased this stone and directly compared it with the 3.03ct target-centre candidate in hand (#59/#63/#66). In those home comparisons lovedogs and Ibrakeforpossums preferred the 3.03ct (#67/#69), while Dreamer_D liked the larger corner cuts, apparent face-up size and windmill appearance of this 3.19ct (#68). The eventual wearer preferred this stone, and the buyer reported satisfaction after setting it (#71/#72). Neither a blanket 'bad' judgement nor a blanket technical endorsement fits the full chronology. The Whiteflash listing calls GIA13534682 an EMERALD, despite the forum discussing it among Asscher/square step-cuts: retain the shape classification conflict.
